bagPolicy.summary: Maverik Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Maverik Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Maverik Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Maverik Center offers a variety of food and drink options including burgers, fries, nachos, and ice cream. Highlights include the Bacon Cheeseburger, Chicken Tinga Tacos, and a selection of flavored milkshakes. Special offerings feature a range of desserts and premium items.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Maverik Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Maverik Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Maverik Center Box Office opens at 2:00 PM on event days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Maverik Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
